meta.title: Intake vs Event-Creation User Separation: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and attempt the Intake vs Event-Creation User Separation action.
Sign in as a Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant and verify the action is available.
Compare the refusal or absence for the non-admin with availability for the Tenant Admin, including tenant RBAC configuration.
